Choosing the right protein depends heavily on your budget, fitness goal, and stomach sensitivity.

| --- | --- | --- |
| Optimum Nutrition Gold Standard | Global Gold Standard | 24g protein per scoop, highly trusted worldwide. |

| AS\-IT\-IS Raw Whey | Budget Conscious | Unflavoured, lab\-tested, economical protein concentrate. |
| Dymatize ISO 100 | Lactose Intensitive / Cutting | Hydrolyzed isolate with ultra\-fast absorption and minimal carbs. |

### Top Brand Categories Breakdown

- Optimum Nutrition \(ON\): Widely recognized as the international benchmark. It mixes effortlessly, tastes great, and delivers reliable gains, though it comes at a higher price point due to import costs and popularity. [1]
- MuscleBlaze: A leading homegrown Indian brand known for its patent\-pending Biozyme technology which minimizes digestion issues like bloating. It bridges the gap between international quality and local pricing.
- The Whole Truth: Perfect for fitness enthusiasts who prefer completely clean nutrition. They disclose every single ingredient clearly with zero hidden sweeteners, thickeners, or artificial colors. [1]
- AS\-IT\-IS Nutrition: The go\-to option for raw, unflavoured, pocket\-friendly whey concentrate. It is unmasked, meaning you get pure protein powder without any added flavors. [1]
- Myprotein: A popular global direct\-to\-consumer brand offering great variants like [Impact Whey Protein](https://www.myprotein.co.in/c/nutrition/protein/whey-protein-india/) and unique refreshing options like Clear Whey Isolate. [2]
